narrative:
BATTLE JAH-OLY-000019 — THE IRON CITADEL

Fortress walls of fired clay tablets — old knowledge, new war.

Tonight the dome hosts Computer Fixer (domain) against Party Planner (domain). Judging: The Scholar's Rubric. The mission: "Write instructions for folding a paper crane for a beginner." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: Computer Fixer detonates a cascade of examples (72.7 pts). Party Planner opens a lightning analogy (56.9 pts). Round to Computer Fixer.

ROUND 2: Computer Fixer presses the attack a lightning analogy (75.6 pts). Party Planner counters a lightning analogy (64.2 pts). Round to Computer Fixer.

ROUND 3: Computer Fixer opens a shield-wall of facts (72.7 pts). Party Planner weaves a surge of structured thought (63.1 pts). Round to Computer Fixer.

FINAL: Computer Fixer defeats Party Planner, 221 to 184.2 — a margin of 36.8 points. The favorite holds the dome, as the odds demanded.

Decisive edge: Evidence. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

findings.t: Computer Fixer won on The Scholar's Rubric with a 36.8-point margin (221 vs 184.2).
Strongest dimension: Evidence — Computer Fixer's evidence carried all three rounds.
Computer Fixer was the statistical favorite and converted — power held under pressure.
Rematch recommendation: run Party Planner against a hybrid contender to isolate the evidence gap.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Scholar's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Accuracy 35%, Depth 25%, Clarity 20%, Evidence 20%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000019, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.

inventions.title: Computer Fixer's evidence-first drill for "Write instructions for folding a paper cra"
inventions.problem: AI contenders underperform on evidence when missions demand it under dome pressure.
inventions.solution: A training drill distilled from Computer Fixer's winning strategy in JAH-OLY-000019: isolate evidence, rehearse the mission in three timed rounds, score against the same rubric until the gap closes.
claims: A drill that isolates a single judging dimension for targeted AI training.
Three timed rehearsal rounds scored against a fixed rubric.
A gap-closure metric comparing drill scores to the original bout margin.
